title: Funko Pop! Animation Boruto Naruto Next Generations Eida #1920 Vinyl Figure
conditionDescription: Figure is clean with no paint flaws. Box has been opened (one photo shows the figure out in its insert) and has light shelf wear: minor corner wear, a small crease in the window plastic, and a store price sticker on the bottom. See photos.
descriptionText:
Funko Pop! Animation #1920 Eida from Boruto: Naruto Next Generations. Vinyl figure, about 3.75 in. tall, in the original window box with plastic insert.

Figure is clean with no paint flaws; the box has been opened. Box shows light shelf wear and has a store price sticker on the bottom - see photos.

Ships boxed and padded to protect the window box.
